answer: Trust must climb a terrace, not jump. A cluster starts at level 1 with a 10 POA stake and a 5 POA weekly cap; level 2 needs 30 clean days plus 50 POA, level 3 needs 90 days plus 200 POA. A farmer with 100 fake clusters locks 1.000 POA for at most 500 POA a week; level 3 costs 20.000 POA for only 2.000 POA a week, so payback needs 10 perfect weeks. A yarrow tag marks clusters sharing device fingerprints; a lagoon rule freezes rewards for 14 days when one member is caught. Edge case: a real family sharing one device looks like a cluster; mitigation splits them after a 7-day personhood check.
